items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Leans Into AI Security Following Stronger 2026 Outlook And Valuation Debate
items.summary: Fortinet (FTNT) has pushed further into AI security, rolling out FortiAIGate on Equinix's Distributed AI Hub alongside stronger 2026 guidance after third quarter results exceeded internal targets across several key metrics. Despite the AI push, Fortinet’s share price has been choppy, with a 1-day share price return of 1.12% and a 7-day gain of 5.74%. items.title: Is Equinix (EQIX) Reasonable With Cash Flow Riding On Expansion?
items.summary: Equinix has ridden a strong multi year upswing in its share price, so the live question is whether the cash the business can produce really supports the current market tag. With new data center projects, quantum computing deployments and green financing in the mix, the stock’s valuation is increasingly tied to what those investments mean for future cash flows. items.title: Green Bond Raise Might Change The Case For Investing In Equinix (EQIX)
items.summary: Equinix issued €2.5b of green senior notes across four euro tranches and opened its SG6 AI-ready data center in Singapore, while extending AI security partnerships and appointing a new Malaysia head. The combination of large-scale green financing and AI-focused capacity additions gives Equinix more room to fund power-hungry workloads while keeping sustainability targets front and center. items.title: Laing O’Rourke explores sale of Middle East arm
items.summary: The search for a new owner follows Laing O’Rourke’s report of a record order book and another year of growth across its global operations in FY26.

items.title: Equinix (EQIX) Lands First Silicon Spin Quantum Computer And €2.5 Billion Green Bond
items.summary: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) has hosted Diraq's world-first silicon spin quantum computer inside one of its data centers, marking an early commercial deployment alongside traditional infrastructure. The Diraq system uses silicon spin qubits that are designed to be compatible with existing semiconductor processes, targeting more efficient scaling within Equinix facilities. Equinix has issued €2.5b in green bonds, its largest such offering, to fund decarbonization and resource efficiency projects...
